mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, we have clear skies over Harriet Park with a beautiful waxing gibbous moon. You can also spot the International Space Station at 3:24 AM as it travels from Mount Horeb toward the Fitchburg area reaching halfway up the sky. Expect an overnight low of 56 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is accepting applications for an Engineering Technician to manage municipal construction projects until September 20. Additionally, the city has implemented a new rain barrel rebate program offering thirty dollars for eligible property owners to help manage stormwater.

We have a busy weekend ahead. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking forward, don't miss the free Girls Try Hockey event tomorrow at the Verona Ice Arena.

On August 15, Verona police officers performed a welfare check on a vehicle near North Main Street and Cross Country Road, which resulted in the arrest of a 44-year-old Fitchburg woman for her first offence O W I.
You are in luck because today's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight.
